target_customer: B2B sales teams and founders running outbound
problem: Outbound requires buying several tools, hiring SDRs or agencies and guessing which leads and messages work.
business_model: SaaS subscription (Pro listed at 99 dollars per month by a third party)
product_category: AI go to market agents for outbound sales

founders.name: Pierre-Eliott Lallemant
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

founders.name: Roman Czerny
previous_startups: CoCo AI (Shopify app, about 500K ARR, sold 2025 per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Other profiles attribute Edusign to him; sources conflict.

competitors.name: Instantly
competitors.traction_then: high volume sending with unlimited inboxes

technical_complexity.rationale: Detecting LinkedIn intent signals, enrichment and automated outreach uses existing APIs and model calls; platform access is the main difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar tools exist and comparison pages list a crowded field; cross customer learning could build data over time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors added AI and signal features; no action against Gojiberry found.

market_need_then: Company reports 2,000 plus customers, 2.5M ARR in 10 months and profitability (YC page, self reported with inconsistent figures across the page).

branding.domain_note: Uses gojiberry.ai; an older gojiberry.app domain also exists.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct claims about reply rates and meetings booked

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt recognition claimed in a company press release and many comparison pages; the company runs its own SEO blog of alternatives pages.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive fruit name that stands out among sales tools and gets third party reviews, but no independent brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Gojiberry is active and reportedly profitable with fast growth from founders who had two prior exits and used SEO and multichannel outreach. Traction figures are self reported and inconsistent, and the space is crowded with larger enrichment and outreach tools.
notes: Funding conflicts: VCBacked and Neuronfeed say 500K total, StartupHub says 2M, all aggregators with no primary announcement, so no round is recorded. Founder education not found. Competitor sources are vendor authored comparison pages dated 2025 and 2026. Founder roles differ across profiles. Completeness pass: Round rests on single databases and the amount and date conflict: VCBacked and Neuronfeed say 500K (June 2026 and January 2026), Caplight says 1M, StartupHub says 2M; the 500K figure is recorded with year only and the stage is unknown. No press release found.
